facts.claim_text: Continue cardiac monitoring with ST segment monitoring and alarms on, given rising troponin T and CK-MB.
notes: concept set by the rule files: cardiac -> other
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: Serial Troponin T measurements show a rising trend: 0.7 ng/mL at 00:19, 1.37 ng/mL at 03:58, and 1.82 ng/mL at 09:58 on 2167-11-08, all before the decision time.

facts.claim_text: Continue cardiac monitoring with ST segment monitoring and alarms on, given rising troponin T and CK-MB.
notes: concept set by the rule files: cardiac -> other
facts.label: not_supported
facts.reason: CK-MB rose from 157 ng/mL (00:19) to 178 ng/mL (03:58), but the most recent measurement before the decision time shows 171 ng/mL (09:58), a decrease from the prior value, so the records show CK-MB is not rising.
